Could not find compatible versions

Because sinatra >= 2.1.0, < 3.0.0 depends on rack ~> 2.2
  and sinatra >= 2.0.0.beta1, < 2.1.0 depends on rack ~> 2.0,
  sinatra >= 2.0.0, < 3.0.0 requires rack >= 2.0, < 3.A.
And because rackup >= 2.0.0 depends on rack >= 3,
  rackup >= 2.0.0 is incompatible with sinatra >= 2.0.0, < 3.0.0.
So, because Gemfile depends on sinatra ~> 2.0
  and Gemfile depends on rackup >= 2,
  version solving has failed.
